crossRefs.note: When I was told that the Jews lay in wait for the man, I sent him to you immediately, charging his accusers also to…
I answered them that it is not the custom of the Romans to give up any man to destruction before the accused has met…

people.name: Asia
people.line: A Roman province in western Asia Minor.

translations.web: They ought to have been here before you, and to make accusation, if they had anything against me.
translations.bsb: who ought to appear before you and bring charges, if they have anything against me.
translations.kjv: Who ought to have been here before thee, and object, if they had ought against me.
translations.asv: who ought to have been here before thee, and to make accusation, if they had aught against me.
